LLM auditresponse for PKGBUILD:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD is a standard Arch User Repository (AUR) package recipe for bundling font files extracted from an Android archive maintained by Niek. It retrieves a prebuilt zip file (`fonts-android.zip`) from a GitHub release URL tied to the declared upstream project, `https://github.com/Niek/fonts-extractor`, which matches the package description. The `sha256sums` array contains a valid checksum that ensures the integrity of the downloaded archive.

The `prepare()` function extracts the archive using `bsdtar`, a safe and standard tool for handling archives in AUR builds. The `package()` function installs `.ttf`, `.otf`, `.ttc`, and `.otc` font files to the appropriate system font directory and copies relevant license and notice files to the license directory. These operations are typical for font packages and do not involve executing downloaded code or modifying system behavior beyond file installation.

No network requests, dynamic code evaluation, obfuscated commands, or unexpected system modifications are present. The use of `find` with `-print0` and null-delimited input ensures robust handling of filenames with special characters. The final check ensures that at least one font file was installed, preventing silent failures. All actions are consistent with standard packaging practices for font bundles.
</details>
<evidence>

</evidence>
